selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What covers the whole earth in the passage?
questions.answer: The basic materials of creation cover the whole earth.

questions.question: What else is spread all over the earth besides the elements?
questions.answer: Different kinds of living and created things are spread all over it.

questions.question: What do these things show about Allah?
questions.answer: They show that one Allah made and owns them.

questions.question: Why does their being spread everywhere help prove oneness?
questions.answer: Because the same kinds are found across the earth in an ordered way, so they point to one Maker.

questions.question: How are the elements described in relation to that one Maker?
questions.answer: They are like obedient servants.

questions.question: How are the different species described in relation to that one Maker?
questions.answer: They are like well-trained soldiers.

questions.question: What do the words about servants and soldiers help us understand?
questions.answer: They help us understand Allah’s great power and control.

questions.question: Does the passage say there are many owners of creation or one owner?
questions.answer: One owner.

questions.question: What does the writer do after giving this short proof?
questions.answer: He says this truth is explained more fully in other places and keeps this part brief.

questions.question: After these truths, who speaks to his own heart?
questions.answer: The traveler speaks to his heart.

questions.question: In the passage, what is said about the building blocks of creation on earth?
questions.answer: They are found all across the earth.

questions.question: What is said about the groups of created things on earth?
questions.answer: Each kind is spread widely over the earth.

questions.question: What sign do these groups carry?
questions.answer: They carry a sign that points to unity.

questions.question: If many kinds are spread across the world in this way, what does that tell us about their Maker?
questions.answer: It tells us they come from one Maker.

questions.question: What does the passage say about who these things belong to?
questions.answer: They belong to a single being.

questions.question: What picture is used for the elements?
questions.answer: They are pictured as strong servants that obey.

questions.question: What picture is used for the species?
questions.answer: They are pictured as disciplined soldiers.

questions.question: What can we infer about the Maker from these two pictures?
questions.answer: He is very powerful and rules over all of them.

questions.question: Why is the explanation here short?
questions.answer: Because the fuller explanation was already given elsewhere.

questions.question: What feeling leads the traveler to speak to his heart after the Five Truths?
questions.answer: Strong faith and happiness in Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What two big parts of creation are talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The elements and the different species.

questions.question: Where are the elements found?
questions.answer: Throughout the whole earth.

questions.question: Where are the species found?
questions.answer: They are spread throughout the earth too.

questions.question: What important lesson comes from both being spread everywhere?
questions.answer: The lesson is that they all come from one Lord.
